nodes.label: Design System Generator (search.py --design-system)
nodes.rationale: Always start with --design-system so a complete, reasoned design system (pattern, style, colors, typography, effects, anti-patterns) is produced before any detail search; --persist creates a MASTER.md plus per-page override files so page rules can override global rules across sessions.

nodes.label: Accessibility Guidelines (Priority 1, CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Ranked highest of ten rule categories because contrast, keyboard navigation, aria-labels and reduced-motion failures break usability entirely rather than merely degrading polish.

nodes.label: The Ladder (decision ladder for minimal solutions)
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first rung that holds: skip entirely (YAGNI), then stdlib, then native platform feature, then already-installed dependency, then one line, and only then minimum custom code — because the best code is the code never written and each lower rung adds maintenance cost.
nodes.norm_label: the ladder (decision ladder for minimal solutions)

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Marker convention
nodes.rationale: Deliberate simplifications are marked in code with a ponytail: comment naming the ceiling and the upgrade path, so a shortcut reads as intent rather than ignorance and can later be harvested into a debt ledger.

nodes.label: Ponytail Gain Skill (benchmark scoreboard)
nodes.rationale: Never prints a per-repo savings number because the unbuilt version was never written, so there is no real baseline to subtract from; the only real per-repo figures come from the counted ponytail-debt ledger.

nodes.label: Sims 4 Mod Manager Development Plan
nodes.rationale: Staged so each stage is self-contained and shippable; security (Stage 0) precedes all features because Electron 31 stopped receiving Chromium patches while the app renders remote content from Tumblr/Patreon/CurseForge.

nodes.label: Stage 0 Security Hardening (sandbox, CSP, safeStorage)
nodes.rationale: Electron upgrade to 43, sandbox:true, contextIsolation, navigation guards, openExternal validation (https only), strict CSP via session.onHeadersReceived, and safeStorage encryption of the CurseForge key — all done before new features because the app opens login windows and renders untrusted remote content.

nodes.label: Mod Conflict Detector (TGI resource intersection)
nodes.rationale: Killer feature: reuse the existing DBPF parser to collect type/group/instance resource sets per .package and intersect them across mods; a whitelist of known-safe overlaps (tuning injectors, shared libraries) is required to avoid false positives.

nodes.label: Sims 4 Mod Manager README
nodes.rationale: Positioned as an unofficial MIT-licensed fan tool that only accesses publicly available content and honors paywalls; session-cookie reuse for Patreon/Pinterest login means the app never sees the user's password.
